paite: Huchi in Zeruiah tapa Joab in kumpipa lungsim Absalom tung ah a-om chih ana thei hi.
heading: Joab In Absalom Hong Kikdan Ding Agel

paite: Huchi in Joab in Tekoa ah mi asawl a, huai a numei pil khat ava pisak hi. Akiang ah, "Lusuun bang in kibawl inla, lusuun puan silh inla, sathau leng kinilh lou in numei sawtpi misi suun bang in om in.
Kumpipa kiang ah hoh inla, akiang ah hichibang in thu va gen in aw,"” achi hi. Huchi in Joab in akam ah thute amuam hi.
Tekoa a numei in kumpipa kiang a thu gen ding in amai a lei si in abokkhup a, zahtakna pia in, "Kumpipa aw, hon huh in," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Bangchidan ahia?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Meithai petmah ka hi a, ka pasal asita hi.
Na sikhanu'n tapa nih anei a, anih un lou ah akisual ua, kuamah phelh ding lah a-om kei a, akhat pen in adang asat a, athatta hi.

Ngai in, a-inkuan tengteng in na sikhanu adoukhawm ua, a-unaupa thatpa, a-unaupa athah ziak a ka thah sam theihna ding un hon pekhia in, huchi in gouluah dingpa leng ka that pah ngal ding uh, achi uh. Huchibang in ka mei-am omsun amitsak ding ua, ka pasal min nei lou leh leitung a suan himhim nei lou in a-om mai ding," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n numei kiang ah, "Na inn ah pai inla, na tungtang thu ah thu ka pe mai ding," achi hi.
Tekoa a numei in kumpipa kiang ah, "Ka toupa, kumpipa aw, huai gitlouhna moh ka tung leh ka pa inkote tung ah ke mai hen. Kumpipa leh alaltutphah in moh po kei hen," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n, "Kuapeuh na tung a banghiam gen peuhmah ka kiang ah hon pi inla, ahon khoih nawn het kei ding uh," achi hi.

Ama'n, "Sisan suah mite tung a phula mite'n hihmang nawn lou ding in kumpipa'n TOUPA na Pathian theigige hen aw, huchi lou in zaw ka tapa ahihmang kha ding uh," achi hi. Ama'n, "TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi, na tapa samzang khat lel leng lei ah ake kei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in numei in, "Na sikhanu in toupa ka kumpipa kiang ah thu kam khat kia ka hon gen nawn peuhmah ding aw," achi hi. Ama'n, "Gen ve," achi hi.
Numei in, "Ahihleh bangziak in ahia Pathian mite dou a hichibang a hih tum na hia? Hiai thu a pan kumpipa moh in akilang ahi, kumpipa'n adelhmangpa apikik nawn louh ziak in.
Ka si ngeingei ding ua, lei a bosa luah nawn theih louh tuisik bang ka hi uh. Pathian in hinna alamang kei a, adelhmangpa amah a pan hawlkhiak ahihlouhna ding lunggel ahi zaw hi.
Huchi in toupa ka kumpipa kiang a hiai thu gen dia ka hong leng mite'n ahon lauhsak ziak uh ahi. Na sikhanu'n, kumpipa kiang ah ka gen phot dia, kumpipa'n asikhanu nget ahihsak khakleh, ka chi a ahi.
Kumpipa'n kei leh ka tapa Pathian gouluah lou dia hihman tum mi lak a na sikhanu hunkhe ding in ana ngaikhe ding, ka chi hi.

Huchi in na sikhanu a ding in, toupa ka kumpipa thu lungmuanhuaitak hi henla; asia-apha na khen ding in toupa ka kumpipa lah Pathian angel bang mai ahi ngal a. TOUPA Pathian na kiang ah om hen, ka chi ahi," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n adawng a, numei kiang ah, "K'on dot peuhmah bangmah hon iim ke'n aw," achi hi. Numei in, "Toupa ka kumpipa'n genleh ake," achi hi.

Kumpipa'n, "Hiai thu himhim ah Joab in panna anei hia?" achi hi. Numei in adawng a, "Toupa ka kumpipa, na kha ahin bang in ka gen ahi, toupa ka kumpipa'n agensa kuamah in taklam hiam, veilam ah hiam apel thei kei ding uh. Na sikha Joab in hon sawl a, hiai thu tengteng na sikhanu ahon muam vek hi.
Thil omdan hihlamdang ding in hiai thil na sikha Joab in ahih ahi. Ka toupa bel leitung a thil om tengteng theithei Pathian angel bang a pil ahi," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n Joab kiang ah, "Ngai in, ka hih samta hi. Huaiziak in pai inla, tangval Absalom va pi nawn lechin maw," achi hi.

Joab in amai a lei si in abokkhup a, kumpipa kiang ah kipahthu agen hi. Joab in, "Toupa ka kumpipa aw, toupa'n asikha ngetna alohchinsak ziak in tuni in na sikha in na mitmuh in deihsakna atang chih ka na theita hi," achi hi.
Huchi in Joab athou a, Geshur ah ahoh a, Jerusalem ah Absalom ahon pita hi.
Kumpipa'n, "Ama inn ah pai henla, ka mel hong mu kei hen," achi hi. Huchi in ama inn ah Absalom apai a, kumpipa mel amuta kei hi.
Israel tengteng lak ah Absalom bang a melhoih a phat loh kuamah a-om kei uh. Akhenuai a pan alusip pha in gensiatna himhim a-om kei hi.
heading: Kumpipa Toh Absalom Kilem Nawn

paite: Asam amet chiang in, kum kivei teng in ametsak a, asam lah agik ziak in amet zel hi, abuk zel a, kumpipa bukna shekel zanih apha hi.
Absalom in tapa thum leh tanu khat anei a, amin Tamar ahi a, melhoihtak ahi.
Absalom kum nih hilhial Jerusalem ah a-om a; himahleh kumpipa mel himhim amu kei hi.
Absalom in kumpipa kiang a amah sawl ding in Joab athukhak hi. Himahleh ahoh nuam kei a, athukhak nawn in leng ahoh nuam tuan kei hi.
Huchi in asikhate kiang ah, "I aw, Joab lou, kei lou kiang ahi a, barli buh anei a, va hal un," achi hi. Huchi in Absalom sikhate'n lou ava hal uhi.
Huchi in Joab athou a, Absalom kiang ah a-inn ah ahoh a, "Bangziak a na sikhate'n ka lou hal ahi ua?" achi hi.

Absalom in Joab adawng a, "Ngai dih, bang ding a Geshur a pan hong pai ka hia? Huai ah omden leng kei a dia hoihzaw mah ding hiven. Kumpipa kiang a sawl dia hon thukhak ka hi. Huaiziak in tu in kumpipa mel hon musak in. Tatlekna nei ka hihleh hon that maileh ake," achi hi.
Kumpipa kiang ah Joab ahoh a, ahilh hi. Ama'n Absalom asam a, kumpipa kiang ah ahoh a, kumpipa ma ah amai a lei si in abokkhup a; huchi in kumpipa'n Absalom atawp hi.
